title: Opening New Commercial Conversations for an API Supplier
challenge: An API manufacturer wanted to reach formulation companies and international pharmaceutical buyers but had difficulty getting past procurement gatekeepers.
solution: Myntmore built segmented prospect lists covering formulation manufacturers, exporters and pharmaceutical sourcing companies. We positioned the manufacturer around product availability, documentation, regulatory readiness and dependable supply. Personalised LinkedIn outreach was supported by educational founder content.
results: 7 requests for product or technical documentation.
